finding_reviews.rationale: Carried entry fails both tests. (a) The carried source DC-0001825384-c813c125ac (reviewed, supported) concludes false_alarm, but the report labels this finding source_ambiguity, so the carry does not reproduce its source. (b) affected_rows is a free-text description, not row keys; the rule's current flagged rows are ROW-0559f58dbdd28c51 (revolver, -55,835) and ROW-1b22231b43acd84a (term loan, 48,015,079), which cannot be shown equal to the carried coverage. Substantively, the carry no longer holds: in this same run the investigator treated the identical 'Two Ten Holdco, Inc' vs printed '2-10 Holdco, Inc.' rendering as a confirmed error and renamed it by row correction in 2023-09-30, 2023-12-31, 2024-03-31, 2024-06-30 and 2024-09-30 (term loan), while carrying a 'no data identity repair' verdict here. Result: the same position_id c1ad442f... is published as 'Two Ten Holdco, Inc' in 2023-03/06 and '2-10 Holdco, Inc.' later, and in 2024-09-30 the added revolver row is 'Two Ten Holdco, Inc' beside the renamed term loan. The owner ruling DC-shared-e67718e0e3 puts these renderings in scope of the issuer_name_printed check repair, which argues against the later renames, not for them. One treatment must be chosen for all quarters (either rename 2023-03/06 too, or drop the 2023-09..2024-09 renames and rely on the check repair).

Carried source DC-0001825384-b0a2ab0bda exists and was reviewed (supported, false_alarm), and its evidence covers both flagged lines (ROW-4e0c01421969d262 revolver -44,216; ROW-5d8aef548ac73f61 term loan 47,597,902). But affected_rows is the free text '2023-06-30 Two Ten Holdco rows', not row keys, so equality with the flagged population is not demonstrated. The carry is also contradicted by the run's own renames of the same rendering in the five following quarters (see RVQ_BLK_389476a6b5a8): the verdict says no data repair is established, the run applied one elsewhere, leaving the position's published name split across quarters. Rejected until one consistent treatment is applied.
